VS-ALEMBIC.art_direction: A mystical alchemy laboratory with a large central cauldron swirling with four colors of glowing essence, copper pipes, alembics and flasks, star charts on the wall, and four colored crystal jars on the counter.
VS-ALEMBIC.concept: A mystical alchemy lab where four colored essences swirl into one cauldron.
VS-ALEMBIC.goods: Crafting: trade essence + gold for multi-path cards (tri-path after the postgame).
VS-ALEMBIC.notes: Shows essence totals per Path; choose two Paths; the crafting animation plays in the cauldron.

VS-BEETSWORTH.art_direction: A tidy, overly organized armory-office with a metal desk-counter, perfectly aligned weapon racks and armor stands, filing cabinets, a half-open desk drawer full of hidden blades, a framed blank certificate, and a window showing a beet farm.
VS-BEETSWORTH.concept: A rigidly organized armory-office: labeled racks, a desk drawer of hidden blades, a beet farm through the window.
VS-BEETSWORTH.notes: Equipment grouped by slot (helm, weapon, armor, boots, relic) with compare-to-equipped tooltips.

VS-BELLOWS.art_direction: An announcer's booth high in a colosseum, with a brass megaphone on the ledge, faction banners, a prize podium with gleaming trophies, and a sunny arena with a cheering crowd beyond.
VS-BELLOWS.concept: An announcer's booth overlooking the arena sand: banners, a prize podium, a roaring crowd.
VS-BELLOWS.goods: Arena encounter list and arena-exclusive prizes.
VS-BELLOWS.notes: Encounter list with rules, rewards, and completion status; prize showcase.

VS-BENCHLEY.art_direction: A bright gym pro shop with lockers, a trophy wall, stacked protein tubs, dumbbell racks, a whistle on a hook, and a sunny window looking out onto floating islands.
VS-BENCHLEY.concept: A gym pro shop: cards stacked like protein tubs, a trophy wall.
VS-BENCHLEY.goods: Advanced Beefcake cards; Beefcake Path Packs after unlock.
VS-BENCHLEY.notes: Cards shown in 'supplement' tubs; purchases trigger a motivational shout.

VS-FENWICK.art_direction: A small shop that feels like a shrine, with sealed card packs on velvet pedestals under spotlights, shimmering foil streamers, four pedestals with colored cloth covers, and a glass case of glittering foil cards.
VS-FENWICK.concept: A shrine to card packs: packs on velvet pedestals under spotlights, foil glinting everywhere.
VS-FENWICK.goods: Path Packs (each unlocks after that Path's dungeon is cleared).
VS-FENWICK.notes: Locked Path Packs shown as covered pedestals with a hint; pack opening plays right here.

VS-FIGSLY.art_direction: A secret smuggler's den behind a false bookshelf, unmarked crates, a coat rack hung with goods, glinting gilded card packs in an open hidden compartment, a single shielded candle, and a lookout slit in the wall.
VS-FIGSLY.concept: A hidden smuggler's den: goods in secret compartments, a lookout slit, shielded candles.
VS-FIGSLY.notes: Items revealed from 'hidden compartments' on hover.

VS-GRISTLE.art_direction: A rustic junk-trader's porch stall made from salvaged wood, jars and tin cans full of cards, a rocking chair, wind chimes made of spoons, hay bales, and wildflowers growing out of an old boot.
VS-GRISTLE.concept: A junk-trader's porch stall: cards in tin cans and jars, raccoons rummaging.
VS-GRISTLE.goods: Advanced Refusemancer cards; Refusemancer Path Packs after unlock.
VS-GRISTLE.notes: Cards pulled out of tin cans; a raccoon occasionally peeks in (comedy only).

VS-LEDGERBONE.art_direction: A gloomy government service counter with a glass partition, a service bell, trays of forms, a giant rubber stamp, filing cabinets behind, and a flickering green lamp.
VS-LEDGERBONE.concept: A government service window: ticket display, forms in triplicate, a bell for service.
VS-LEDGERBONE.goods: Advanced Necrocrat cards; Necrocrat Path Packs after unlock.
VS-LEDGERBONE.notes: Purchases get a quick comedic 'stamp' animation (no extra steps).

VS-MIREPOIX.art_direction: An elegant fine-dining room with a white-tablecloth counter, silver cloches, a sommelier cart, a chandelier, copper pots on the wall, and warm candlelight.
VS-MIREPOIX.concept: A fine-dining tasting menu: cards presented under silver cloches, candlelight.
VS-MIREPOIX.goods: Advanced Gourmand cards; Gourmand Path Packs after unlock.
VS-MIREPOIX.notes: Each card is 'unveiled' from under a cloche on hover.

VS-SABLE.art_direction: A plush velvet card salon with a polished dark-wood counter, glass display cases of glowing cards arranged like jewelry, framed rare cards on the walls, candle sconces, and a deep-red curtain behind the counter.
VS-SABLE.concept: A glamorous velvet card salon: cards displayed like jewelry under glass, rare misprints framed on the wall.
VS-SABLE.goods: Single cards; General Packs (Tier 1, Tier 2 after unlock).
VS-SABLE.notes: Cards shown as fanned rows; hover zooms the card; the Tier 2 shelf appears with a sparkle when unlocked.

VS-THREADWELL.art_direction: A flamboyant boutique with towering hat stands, cloaks on mannequins, bolts of colorful fabric, a gilded full-length mirror under a spotlight, a small runway carpet, and scattered pins and ribbons on the counter.
VS-THREADWELL.concept: A dramatic boutique: hat stands everywhere, a spotlit mirror, a tiny runway.
VS-THREADWELL.notes: Uses a live character preview so the player can try items on before buying.

VS-TONIC.art_direction: A cozy, chaotic apothecary with a wooden counter covered in bubbling flasks and mortar-and-pestles, shelves of glowing colorful potions, hanging dried herbs, a scorch mark on the ceiling, and a small steaming cauldron in the corner.
VS-TONIC.concept: A cluttered, bubbling apothecary: potions fizzing, a small explosion scorch mark on the ceiling.
VS-TONIC.goods: Consumable items (basic half; advanced half unlocks by level).
VS-TONIC.notes: Items shown as bottles on shelves; the locked advanced shelf sits behind a frosted glass door.
